list.item: Four months of crampy right lower abdominal pain, loose stools up to six times a day including at night, low-grade evening fevers, and loss of 6 kg; inflammatory markers raised; colonoscopy and small-bowel imaging booked: active, confirmed [S]
Iron deficiency anemia from chronic intestinal blood loss and poor absorption (hemoglobin 10.6 g/dL, MCV 76, ferritin 9): active, confirmed [S]
Moderate protein-calorie malnutrition: BMI 17.6 after losing 6 kg (12 percent of body weight) in four months; albumin 3.3 g/dL: active, confirmed [S]
Vitamin D deficiency (25-hydroxyvitamin D 18 ng/mL): active, confirmed [S]

Workup for suspected inflammatory bowel disease: blood count, CRP, albumin, iron studies, vitamin B12 and D, fecal calprotectin, stool tests for Clostridioides difficile and enteric pathogens, celiac serology, a pregnancy test, ileocolonoscopy with biopsies, and MR enterography. Guideline: ACG Clinical Guideline: Management of Crohn's Disease in Adults. Am J Gastroenterol 2025;120(6):1225-1264 (2025); ECCO-ESGAR Guideline for Diagnostic Assessment in IBD Part 1: Initial diagnosis, monitoring of known IBD, detection of complications. J Crohns Colitis 2019 (2019) [S]

Exclude intestinal tuberculosis before any steroid or immunosuppressive drug: interferon-gamma release assay, chest X-ray, and ileal and colonic biopsies for acid-fast stain, TB PCR, and mycobacterial culture; with hepatitis B, hepatitis C, HIV, measles, and varicella serology before treatment. Guideline: ACG Clinical Guideline: Management of Crohn's Disease in Adults. Am J Gastroenterol 2025;120(6):1225-1264 (2025); ECCO Guidelines on the Prevention, Diagnosis, and Management of Infections in Inflammatory Bowel Disease. J Crohns Colitis 2026 (2026) [S]

Gastroenterology (inflammatory bowel disease) consultation once the endoscopy and imaging are done, to confirm the diagnosis and choose treatment with her. Guideline: ACG Clinical Guideline: Management of Crohn's Disease in Adults. Am J Gastroenterol 2025;120(6):1225-1264 (2025); AGA Clinical Practice Guidelines on the Medical Management of Moderate to Severe Luminal and Perianal Fistulizing Crohn's Disease. Gastroenterology 2021 (2021) [S]

Nutrition: dietitian assessment, small frequent meals with oral nutritional supplements, and weight at every visit. Guideline: ECCO Guidelines on Therapeutics in Crohn's Disease: Medical Treatment. J Crohns Colitis 2024;18(10):1531-1555 (2024); ACG Clinical Guideline Update: Preventive Care in Inflammatory Bowel Disease. Am J Gastroenterol 2025;120:1447-1473 (2025) [S]

Mood, anxiety, and work: PHQ-9 and GAD-7 at intervals, IBD psychology if needed, and a practical plan for composing and performing during treatment. Guideline: ACG Clinical Guideline Update: Preventive Care in Inflammatory Bowel Disease. Am J Gastroenterol 2025;120:1447-1473 (2025) [S]
